steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each requirement is matched to its answer and its source. A requirement with no answer is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Requirement with no answer
findings.fix: Write the answer and its source

findings.title: Price differs from the price notes
findings.fix: Reconcile the price to the approved notes

findings.title: Term the RFP asks for that the organisation does not have

outcome.notChecked: Whether the capability works as described, and the legal effect of any term.
